αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing, epithet of Zeus (meaning disputed, usually ’holding the αἰγίς’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
αἰζηῶν: αἰζηός — vigorous young man; masc. gen. pl.: ’young men’
αἰνὸν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome, grim; neut. nom./acc. sg. (αἰνὸν ἄχος ’fearsome grief’)
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἴας: Αἴας — Ajax, Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
αὐτοὺς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ (grave, mid-clause form) · also intensive, masc. acc. pl., in apposition: ’themselves’ (καὶ αὐτοὺς Ἀργείους ’the Argives themselves’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’ourselves’ (αὐτοὺς … ὑπεκφυγέειν ’ourselves to flee’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ … μάχεσθαι ’and himself to fight’) · also intensive, agreeing with a noun: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν βασιλῆα ’the king himself’)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὐχένα: αὐχήν — neck; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐξ … ἄξῃ (tmesis): ’breaks the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of βάλλω: ’hit the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of τύπτε: ’struck the neck’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv. (cf. αὖθις)
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’threw, dashed’ · also ’hit, struck’ a target (κατ’ ἀσπίδα … βάλε ’hit the shield’) · also ’put on, fitted’ in tmesis (ἀμφ’ ὀχέεσσι … βάλε ’fitted to the chariot’)
βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαλε): ’hit, struck’
βαθείης: βαθύς — deep; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
βαλέειν: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. inf., epic βαλέειν (= Attic βαλεῖν)
βουλάς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γεφύρας: γέφυρα — bridge; fem. acc. pl.; πολέμοιο γέφυραι is the open ground between armies (sense debated)
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
γλαφυρὰς: γλαφυρός — hollow, well-hollowed; fem. acc. pl., standing epithet of ships (νῆας γλαφυράς)
γνὺξ: γνύξ — on the knees, kneeling; adv.: ’on his knees’
γούνατ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα); ’loosen the knees’ means ’kill, unstring’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέμας: δέμας — bodily frame, build; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in build’
δίφροιο: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot (also a stool, seat); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
δεδεγμένος: δέχομαι — receive; await, wait for; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., + acc.: ’waiting for’
διώκων: διώκω — pursue, chase; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’pursuing’
δόμον: δόμος — house, home; masc. acc. sg.
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg. mid./pass. dep., + inf.: ’I am able’
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable · also δύω — go into, put on (armour); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short-vowel subj. after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’I put on’ (τεύχεα δύω)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’)
εἴασε: ἐάω — let, allow, leave alone; aor. 3 sg. act. (augment εἰ-): ’let (him lie), left’
εἴπῃ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’whoever may speak’
εὖτέ: εὖτε — when; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ὅτε)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θέτιδος: Θέτις — Thetis, a sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. gen. sg.
θέων: θέω — run, speed; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’running’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
θρασὺν: θρασύς — bold, daring; adj., masc. acc. sg.
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ἀποπνείων ’breathing out his life’)
θυμός: θυμός — life, the life-breath that leaves the body; also heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θωρήξομαι: θωρήσσω — arm, put on armour; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall arm myself’, with dat. of the foe: ’against him’
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’head’ (ἐστήριξε κάρη ’planted her head’)
κίε: κίω — go, go one’s way; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (Attic ᾔει from εἶμι): ’went’
καίριόν: καίριος — vital, deadly (of the spot where a wound kills); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’deadly’
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’
καλλίτριχας: καλλίθριξ — fair-maned (καλός + θρίξ); masc. acc. pl., of horses
καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. · also καρπός — fruit, produce; masc. dat. sg.
κασιγνήτοιο: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with οἷο agreeing: ’of his own brother’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’)
κομόωντας: κομάω — wear one’s hair long; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic diectasis (= Attic κομῶντας)
κορυθαίολος: κορυθαίολος — with glancing, flashing helmet; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Hector
κύδιστε: κύδιστος — most glorious, greatest; masc. voc. sg., superlative, address
λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε); λαβεῖν + gen. ’take hold of’
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
λευκώλενος: λευκώλενος — white-armed; adj., nom. sg. (epithet of women, e.g. Nausicaa)
λισσομένη: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’begging’
λύθη: λύω — loose, undo; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐλύθη): ’was loosed’
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’)
μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μαίνεται: μαίνομαι — rage, be frenzied; pres. 3 sg. mid.
μαζόν: μαζός — breast, nipple; masc. acc. sg.
μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’
μεμαῶτα: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. part. (pres. sense) masc. acc. sg. μεμαώς, μεμαῶτα: ’eager, straining’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μώνυχας: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed, with an undivided hoof; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
μὰν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (= Attic μήν); ἦ μάν ’truly indeed’ · also ἄγρει μάν ’come then’ (with the interjection ἄγρει)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νευρῇ: νευρή — bowstring, string; fem. dat. sg., after ἐπί: ’on the string’
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
νῶϊ: ἐγώ — I; pron., 1st pers. dual nom., epic νῶϊ (= Attic νώ): ’we two’ · also dual acc.: ’us two’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οἶτον: οἶτος — fate, doom (usually evil); masc. acc. sg.
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her, to himself’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
οὐρανόθεν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; adv. οὐρανόθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the sky’
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’whose, of which’ · ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’his own’ (οὗ πατρός ’his own father’)
οὗτός: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: ’this man’
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’)
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’)
πατρίδι: πατρίς — of one’s fathers, native; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γαίῃ: ’native (land)’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
πεσόντος: πίπτω — fall, drop; aor. part. act., masc. gen. sg.: ’having fallen’, i.e. slain
πεσὼν: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (aor. stem πεσ-): ’having fallen’
πικρὸν: πικρός — bitter, sharp; adj., masc. acc. sg., with ὀϊστόν
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πριαμίδης: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. nom. sg., patronymic, of Hector · also of another son of Priam (Antiphus) · also of Helenus
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσεφώνεε: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., augmented (προσ- + ἐ-φώνεε): ’was speaking to, addressed’
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πύκασε: πυκάζω — cover thickly, wrap about, enshroud; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπύκασε)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σκόλοπας: σκόλοψ — stake, sharpened pale; masc. acc. pl.
σμερδαλέα: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σπεύδοντα: σπεύδω — hasten, press on; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
στυγεροῦ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. gen. sg.
στυγὸς: Στύξ — the Styx, the underworld river by which the gods swear their most binding oath; fem. gen. sg.
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg.
σχέτλιος: σχέτλιος — cruel, ruthless, hard-hearted; masc. nom. sg., of a person or god
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in this way’ (τάδε μαίνεται ’rages like this’) · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun: ’this’ (τάδε τόξα ’this bow’)
τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., in apposition: ’young, offspring’ (τέκος ἐλάφοιο ’the young of a deer’)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τειρόμενον: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’worn down’
τεύχεσιν: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable
τεῦκρος: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, Greek hero at Troy, half-brother of Ajax; masc. nom. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’)
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τόθ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τόθ’ = τότε)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τόξοισι: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), of means: ’with the bow’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
φέβοντο: φέβομαι — flee, take flight; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., unaugmented (= ἐφέβοντο)
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φαρέτρης: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic φαρέτρας)
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.
χερμάδιον: χερμάδιον — stone that fills the hand, rock; neut. acc. sg.
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable (cf. epic χερσί)
χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
ψυχή: ψυχή — soul, life-breath, the self that leaves at death; fem. nom. sg.
ἀΐδαο: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god and realm of the dead; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Ἅιδου)
ἀγρίου: ἄγριος — wild, savage; adj., masc./fem. gen. sg. (two-ending), agreeing with αἰγός
ἀδελφεὸν: ἀδελφεός — brother (epic form = Attic ἀδελφός); masc. acc. sg.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀκούσας: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of person/thing heard, + acc. of what is said); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having heard’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφεκάλυψε: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round, enfold, enclose, shelter; aor. 3 sg. act. (ἀμφί + καλύπτω)
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (masc./fem.) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀναπλήσαντες: ἀναπίμπλημι — fill up, fill full; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having filled up’
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’)
ἀπίθησεν: ἀπιθέω — disobey; aor. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἀπείθησεν); with οὐκ: ’did not disobey’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀρχεπτόλεμον: Ἀρχεπτόλεμος — Archeptolemus, a Trojan, Hector’s new charioteer (’ruler of battle’); masc. acc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἀχνύμενός: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., accented before περ: ’grieving’
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως) · also by metonymy ’war’ (ἔριδα Ἄρηος ’the strife of war’)
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλέησε: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg. act., + acc.: ’pitied’
ἐμῶν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. pl., agreeing with ὀχέων
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξείλετο: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. take out for oneself, pick out; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took out for himself’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐϊκυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐϊκυῖα (= Attic ἐοικυῖα): ’like’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑλεῖν: αἱρέω — take, seize, kill; aor. inf. act. (stem ἑλ-): ’to take, to slay’
ἑνὸς: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. gen. sg.
ἑτέρωσ: ἑτέρωσε — to the other side, elsewhere; adv., elided (ἑτέρωσ’ = ἑτέρωσε)
ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔκπεσε: ἐκπίπτω — fall out, fall from; aor. 3 sg.: of a tear, ’fell from’ (+ dat. of the person) · also ’fell out of’ + gen., of a broken blade (ἔκπεσε χειρός ’fell from the hand’) · also aor. 3 sg., of a man falling from a vehicle, + gen.: ’fell out of’ (ἔκπεσε δίφρου ’fell out of the chariot’)
ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
ἔοργε: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; perf. 3 sg. act. ἔοργε (from ἔρδω): ’has done’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
ἡνί: ἡνία — reins; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἡνί’ = ἡνία)
ἡνιόχοιο: ἡνίοχος — charioteer, driver; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἤριπε: ἐρείπω — throw down; in the intransitive aor. ἤριπον, fall headlong, crash down; aor. 3 sg.: ’fell headlong’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἰάχων: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’crying out’
ἰδοῦσ: ὁράω — see; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἰδοῦσ’ = ἰδοῦσα; aor. stem ἰδ-): ’having seen’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰῷ: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an arrow’ (not ἰός ’poison’) · also ἰῷ = Attic μιᾷ, ’one’, dat. sg. agreeing with ἤματι (ἰῷ … ἤματι ’on a single day’)
ἴδωμαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with future force: ’shall I see’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I may see’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἵετο: ἵεμαι — hasten, be eager (+ dat./inf.); impf. 3 sg. mid. (middle of ἵημι ’send’)
ὀκριόεντι: ὀκριόεις — jagged, rugged; neut. dat. sg. (-εντι), agreeing with a neut. noun
ὀλλυμένων: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’perishing’
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὄλωνται: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., short-vowel (Attic ἀπόλωνται): ’may perish’; with κεν, ’shall perish’
ὄμματ: ὄμμα — eye; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὄμματ’ = ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’)
ὑπερώησαν: ὑπερωέω — swerve aside, shy (sense uncertain); aor. 3 pl. act., epic, unaugmented
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὠκύποδες: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ὦσαν: ὠθέω — push, thrust back; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσαν): ’pushed’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥῆξε: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρρηξε): ’broke’
